technicalFindings: The prior material treated all Flow references as cold; Flow is an interface and StateFlow/SharedFlow are hot implementations.
A flow builder executes per collection, but two builder invocations are not necessarily two physical HTTP requests if a cache/coalescer is below it.
WhileSubscribed can stop and restart a shared upstream; one active sharing execution is not a forever-once guarantee.

technicalFindings: Initial value is required, not universal non-nullness; MutableStateFlow<User?>(null) is valid.
